OW-BAS-01 - Booking creation — one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026, basic booking, 1 adultPASS
Endpoint Name: Create a one-way booking for 1 adult, Sharjah to Kochi
Request: Searched Sharjah to Kochi for 1 adult on 15 Dec 2026, confirmed the fare, added the passenger and booked
Response: Every step succeeded and a booking reference (6WUOS4) came back
Expected: A booking is created (PNR and booking token returned) for 1 adult; the response lists 1 passenger(s).
Actual: Booking created with reference 6WUOS4. The full request and response were not saved for this first run.
Status: PASS
Evidence
Result line from the first run: "RESULT OW-BAS-01 pnr=6WUOS4 ... correlationId=007415b5-0798-425b-b77b-492dd2f39265 (server)". The full request/response payloads of this first run were NOT retained (the log capture was fixed afterwards); a re-run of this case later returned a Search with no offers (see Findings), so no full payload exists for this PNR.
View Test Case

Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult.
Steps

A booking is created (PNR and booking token returned) for 1 adult; the response lists 1 passenger(s).

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created (PNR and booking token returned) for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant; the response lists 3 passenger(s).
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 65TFMI; 3 passenger(s) in the response; total 8960.38 EGP.
OW-ANC-01 - Booking creation — one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026, booking with ancillaries (seat, meal, baggage), 2 adultsFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026 booking with seat, meal and baggage for 2 adults
Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, added the passengers, asked for the available extras, priced the extras and booked
Response: Booking reference 6UI9JZ came back, but the list of extras offered contained only meals — no baggage and no seats
Expected: A booking is created for 2 adults with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual: Only a meal could be added; baggage and seat could not be chosen, so the booking does not meet the case
Status: FAIL
Evidence
GetAncillary categories offered (all segments): {"Meal":6}. FareConfirm said offerHasAncillary=true, offerHasSeat=true. Meal-only selection was sent to FareCheck (200) and Book (200). Failed check: "Baggage, Meal and Seat all selectable for every passenger/segment".
Hops (6)

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026. Passengers: 2 adults.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → GetAncillary → FareCheck → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 2 adults with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6UI9JZ, but only Meal could be selected: GetAncillary offered {"Meal":6} and no Baggage or Seat items, so the requested seat + meal + baggage combination could not be booked.
OW-ANC-02 - Booking creation — one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026, booking with ancillaries (seat, meal, baggage), 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infantFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026 booking with seat, meal and baggage for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant
Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, added the passengers, asked for the available extras, priced the extras and booked
Response: Booking reference 6ILRUZ came back, but the list of extras offered contained only meals — no baggage and no seats
Expected: A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual: Only a meal could be added; baggage and seat could not be chosen, so the booking does not meet the case
Status: FAIL
Evidence
GetAncillary categories offered (all segments): {"Meal":6}. FareConfirm said offerHasAncillary=true, offerHasSeat=true. Meal-only selection was sent to FareCheck (200) and Book (200). Failed check: "Baggage, Meal and Seat all selectable for every passenger/segment".

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → GetAncillary → FareCheck → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6ILRUZ, but only Meal could be selected: GetAncillary offered {"Meal":6} and no Baggage or Seat items, so the requested seat + meal + baggage combination could not be booked.
OW-BUN-01 - Booking creation — one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026, bundle booking, 1 adultFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026 bundle booking for 1 adult
Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, listed the bundles, picked bundle 66580 (ADT 635.44 EGP), added the passengers and booked
Response: Booking reference 6U77HE came back, but the price and baggage were the same as without the bundle
Expected: A booking is created for 1 adult with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual: The chosen bundle was accepted but not applied: no bundle price was added and no checked baggage was included
Status: FAIL
Evidence
Bundle 66580 priced ADT 635.44 EGP (GetOfferBundles); FareConfirm total 4052.62 EGP; Book total 4052.62 EGP; Book baggageDetails {"carryOnBaggage":"10 Kg (7 Kg bag + 3 Kg personal item)","checkInBaggage":"No Checked baggage"}; Book priceClasses "Basic".

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → GetOfferBundles → AddPassenger → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 1 adult with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6U77HE, but the selected bundle (66580, ADT 635.44 EGP) was not applied: Book total 4052.62 EGP equals the pre-bundle FareConfirm total 4052.62 EGP, and the baggage in the Book response is {"carryOnBaggage":"10 Kg (7 Kg bag + 3 Kg personal item)","checkInBaggage":"No Checked baggage"}.
OW-BUN-02 - Booking creation — one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026, bundle booking, 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infantFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026 bundle booking for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant
Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, listed the bundles, picked bundle 66580 (ADT 635.44 EGP, CHD 635.44 EGP), added the passengers and booked
Response: Booking reference 60BE8Q came back, but the price and baggage were the same as without the bundle
Expected: A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual: The chosen bundle was accepted but not applied: no bundle price was added and no checked baggage was included
Status: FAIL
Evidence
Bundle 66580 priced ADT 635.44 EGP, CHD 635.44 EGP (GetOfferBundles); FareConfirm total 8960.38 EGP; Book total 8960.38 EGP; Book baggageDetails {"carryOnBaggage":"10 Kg (7 Kg bag + 3 Kg personal item)","checkInBaggage":"No Checked baggage"}; Book priceClasses "Basic".

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: one-way SHJ→COK, 15 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → GetOfferBundles → AddPassenger → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 60BE8Q, but the selected bundle (66580, ADT 635.44 EGP, CHD 635.44 EGP) was not applied: Book total 8960.38 EGP equals the pre-bundle FareConfirm total 8960.38 EGP, and the baggage in the Book response is {"carryOnBaggage":"10 Kg (7 Kg bag + 3 Kg personal item)","checkInBaggage":"No Checked baggage"}.
RT-BAS-01 - Booking creation — return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026, basic booking, 1 adultBLOCKED
Endpoint Name: Create a return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026 booking for 1 adult
Request: Searched return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026 for 1 adult
Response: The search succeeded but returned no flights
Expected: A booking is created (PNR and booking token returned) for 1 adult; the response lists 1 passenger(s).
Actual: No flights were available, so no booking could be attempted
Status: BLOCKED
Evidence
Search for return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026 returned an empty offers array. Same-day probe searches showed the SHJ↔COK return pair returning no offers on 3 further attempts, while other return cases had found offers earlier in the run (availability is unstable).

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created (PNR and booking token returned) for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant; the response lists 3 passenger(s).
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6ZOUH2; 3 passenger(s) in the response; total 17315.74 EGP.
RT-ANC-01 - Booking creation — return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026, booking with ancillaries (seat, meal, baggage), 2 adultsFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026 booking with seat, meal and baggage for 2 adults
Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, added the passengers, asked for the available extras, priced the extras and booked
Response: Booking reference 6ICDLN came back, but the list of extras offered contained only meals — no baggage and no seats
Expected: A booking is created for 2 adults with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual: Only a meal could be added; baggage and seat could not be chosen, so the booking does not meet the case
Status: FAIL
Evidence
GetAncillary categories offered (all segments): {"Meal":12}. FareConfirm said offerHasAncillary=true, offerHasSeat=true. Meal-only selection was sent to FareCheck (200) and Book (200). Failed check: "Baggage, Meal and Seat all selectable for every passenger/segment".

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026. Passengers: 2 adults.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → GetAncillary → FareCheck → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 2 adults with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6ICDLN, but only Meal could be selected: GetAncillary offered {"Meal":12} and no Baggage or Seat items, so the requested seat + meal + baggage combination could not be booked.
RT-ANC-02 - Booking creation — return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026, booking with ancillaries (seat, meal, baggage), 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infantFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026 booking with seat, meal and baggage for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant
Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, added the passengers, asked for the available extras, priced the extras and booked
Response: Booking reference 6UBF8H came back, but the list of extras offered contained only meals — no baggage and no seats
Expected: A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual: Only a meal could be added; baggage and seat could not be chosen, so the booking does not meet the case
Status: FAIL
Evidence
GetAncillary categories offered (all segments): {"Meal":12}. FareConfirm said offerHasAncillary=true, offerHasSeat=true. Meal-only selection was sent to FareCheck (200) and Book (200). Failed check: "Baggage, Meal and Seat all selectable for every passenger/segment".

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → GetAncillary → FareCheck → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6UBF8H, but only Meal could be selected: GetAncillary offered {"Meal":12} and no Baggage or Seat items, so the requested seat + meal + baggage combination could not be booked.
RT-BUN-01 - Booking creation — return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026, bundle booking, 1 adultFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026 bundle booking for 1 adult
Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, listed the bundles, picked bundle 66580,66580 (ADT 635.44 EGP), added the passengers and booked
Response: Booking reference 6Q71SF came back, but the price and baggage were the same as without the bundle
Expected: A booking is created for 1 adult with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual: The chosen bundle was accepted but not applied: no bundle price was added and no checked baggage was included
Status: FAIL
Evidence
Bundle 66580,66580 priced ADT 635.44 EGP (GetOfferBundles); FareConfirm total 7419.1 EGP; Book total 7419.1 EGP; Book baggageDetails {"carryOnBaggage":"10 Kg (7 Kg bag + 3 Kg personal item)","checkInBaggage":"No Checked baggage"}; Book priceClasses "Basic".

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: return SHJ→COK 15 Dec and COK→SHJ 22 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → GetOfferBundles → AddPassenger → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 1 adult with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6Q71SF, but the selected bundle (66580,66580, ADT 635.44 EGP) was not applied: Book total 7419.1 EGP equals the pre-bundle FareConfirm total 7419.1 EGP, and the baggage in the Book response is {"carryOnBaggage":"10 Kg (7 Kg bag + 3 Kg personal item)","checkInBaggage":"No Checked baggage"}.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created (PNR and booking token returned) for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant; the response lists 3 passenger(s).
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 66IEW3; 3 passenger(s) in the response; total 11235.12 EGP.
OWC-ANC-01 - Booking creation — one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026, booking with ancillaries (seat, meal, baggage), 2 adultsFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026 booking with seat, meal and baggage for 2 adults
Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, added the passengers, asked for the available extras, priced the extras and booked
Response: Booking reference 6JS8IN came back, but the list of extras offered contained only meals — no baggage and no seats
Expected: A booking is created for 2 adults with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual: Only a meal could be added; baggage and seat could not be chosen, so the booking does not meet the case
Status: FAIL
Evidence
GetAncillary categories offered (all segments): {"Meal":12}. FareConfirm said offerHasAncillary=true, offerHasSeat=true. Meal-only selection was sent to FareCheck (200) and Book (200). Failed check: "Baggage, Meal and Seat all selectable for every passenger/segment".

Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026. Passengers: 2 adults.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → GetAncillary → FareCheck → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 2 adults with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6JS8IN, but only Meal could be selected: GetAncillary offered {"Meal":12} and no Baggage or Seat items, so the requested seat + meal + baggage combination could not be booked.
OWC-ANC-02 - Booking creation — one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026, booking with ancillaries (seat, meal, baggage), 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infantFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026 booking with seat, meal and baggage for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant

Response: Booking reference 6HLOKX came back, but the list of extras offered contained only meals — no baggage and no seats
Expected: A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual: Only a meal could be added; baggage and seat could not be chosen, so the booking does not meet the case
Status: FAIL

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → GetAncillary → FareCheck → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6HLOKX, but only Meal could be selected: GetAncillary offered {"Meal":12} and no Baggage or Seat items, so the requested seat + meal + baggage combination could not be booked.
OWC-BUN-01 - Booking creation — one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026, bundle booking, 1 adultFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026 bundle booking for 1 adult
Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, listed the bundles, picked bundle 66580 (ADT 635.44 EGP), added the passengers and booked
Response: Booking reference 6IZBQ8 came back, but the price and baggage were the same as without the bundle
Expected: A booking is created for 1 adult with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual: The chosen bundle was accepted but not applied: no bundle price was added and no checked baggage was included
Status: FAIL
Evidence
Bundle 66580 priced ADT 635.44 EGP (GetOfferBundles); FareConfirm total 4333.16 EGP; Book total 4333.16 EGP; Book baggageDetails {"carryOnBaggage":"10 Kg (7 Kg bag + 3 Kg personal item)","checkInBaggage":"No Checked baggage"}; Book priceClasses "Basic".

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → GetOfferBundles → AddPassenger → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 1 adult with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6IZBQ8, but the selected bundle (66580, ADT 635.44 EGP) was not applied: Book total 4333.16 EGP equals the pre-bundle FareConfirm total 4333.16 EGP, and the baggage in the Book response is {"carryOnBaggage":"10 Kg (7 Kg bag + 3 Kg personal item)","checkInBaggage":"No Checked baggage"}.
OWC-BUN-02 - Booking creation — one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026, bundle booking, 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infantFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026 bundle booking for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant
Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, listed the bundles, picked bundle 66580 (ADT 635.44 EGP, CHD 635.44 EGP), added the passengers and booked
Response: Booking reference 656AT7 came back, but the price and baggage were the same as without the bundle
Expected: A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual: The chosen bundle was accepted but not applied: no bundle price was added and no checked baggage was included
Status: FAIL
Evidence
Bundle 66580 priced ADT 635.44 EGP, CHD 635.44 EGP (GetOfferBundles); FareConfirm total 11235.12 EGP; Book total 11235.12 EGP; Book baggageDetails {"carryOnBaggage":"10 Kg (7 Kg bag + 3 Kg personal item)","checkInBaggage":"No Checked baggage"}; Book priceClasses "Basic".

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: one-way connection MCT→COK via SHJ, 15 Dec 2026. Passengers: 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → GetOfferBundles → AddPassenger → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 656AT7, but the selected bundle (66580, ADT 635.44 EGP, CHD 635.44 EGP) was not applied: Book total 11235.12 EGP equals the pre-bundle FareConfirm total 11235.12 EGP, and the baggage in the Book response is {"carryOnBaggage":"10 Kg (7 Kg bag + 3 Kg personal item)","checkInBaggage":"No Checked baggage"}.

Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ. Passengers: 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created (PNR and booking token returned) for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant; the response lists 3 passenger(s).
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6CBVXR; 3 passenger(s) in the response; total 21672.56 EGP.
RTC-ANC-01 - Booking creation — return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ, booking with ancillaries (seat, meal, baggage), 2 adultsFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ booking with seat, meal and baggage for 2 adults
Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, added the passengers, asked for the available extras, priced the extras and booked
Response: Booking reference 6O58T0 came back, but the list of extras offered contained only meals — no baggage and no seats
Expected: A booking is created for 2 adults with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual: Only a meal could be added; baggage and seat could not be chosen, so the booking does not meet the case
Status: FAIL
Evidence
GetAncillary categories offered (all segments): {"Meal":24}. FareConfirm said offerHasAncillary=true, offerHasSeat=true. Meal-only selection was sent to FareCheck (200) and Book (200). Failed check: "Baggage, Meal and Seat all selectable for every passenger/segment".

Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ. Passengers: 2 adults.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → GetAncillary → FareCheck → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 2 adults with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 6O58T0, but only Meal could be selected: GetAncillary offered {"Meal":24} and no Baggage or Seat items, so the requested seat + meal + baggage combination could not be booked.

Request: Searched, confirmed the fare, added the passengers, asked for the available extras, priced the extras and booked
Response: Booking reference 67R2WD came back, but the list of extras offered contained only meals — no baggage and no seats
Expected: A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual: Only a meal could be added; baggage and seat could not be chosen, so the booking does not meet the case
Status: FAIL
Evidence
GetAncillary categories offered (all segments): {"Meal":24}. FareConfirm said offerHasAncillary=true, offerHasSeat=true. Meal-only selection was sent to FareCheck (200) and Book (200). Failed check: "Baggage, Meal and Seat all selectable for every passenger/segment".

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ. Passengers: 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → AddPassenger → GetAncillary → FareCheck → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with a seat, a meal and baggage selected for each passenger and segment; the Book response echoes the selected ancillaries.
Actual Result
Booking created, PNR 67R2WD, but only Meal could be selected: GetAncillary offered {"Meal":24} and no Baggage or Seat items, so the requested seat + meal + baggage combination could not be booked.
RTC-BUN-01 - Booking creation — return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ, bundle booking, 1 adultFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ bundle booking for 1 adult
Request: Searched return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ, confirmed the fare, then asked for the available bundles
Response: The bundle request was refused with a conflict error saying no bundles are available
Expected: A booking is created for 1 adult with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual: No bundle could be chosen, so no booking was made, although the fare confirmation had said bundles were available
Status: FAIL
Evidence
GetOfferBundles 409 body: {"Status":409,"TransactionId":"1a89ffb8-7268-455d-841a-6229cbef40bd","ErrorCode":"NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999","ErrorMessage":"NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999","Context":[{"Name":"ServiceBundleError","Value":"No Available Bundles For the Selected Criteria"}]}. ErrorCode and ErrorMessage are both "NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999". FareConfirm flags: haveBundles=true.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ. Passengers: 1 adult.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → GetOfferBundles → AddPassenger → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 1 adult with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual Result
GetOfferBundles returned 409: [{"Name":"ServiceBundleError","Value":"No Available Bundles For the Selected Criteria"}] even though FareConfirm reported haveBundles=true. No booking was made.
RTC-BUN-02 - Booking creation — return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ, bundle booking, 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infantFAIL
Endpoint Name: Create a return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ bundle booking for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant
Request: Searched return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ, confirmed the fare, then asked for the available bundles
Response: The bundle request was refused with a conflict error saying no bundles are available
Expected: A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual: No bundle could be chosen, so no booking was made, although the fare confirmation had said bundles were available
Status: FAIL

View Test Case
Preconditions
Staging ne-6, supplier AirArabiaPlus, credentials USA, V2 API. Itinerary: return connection MCT→COK 15 Dec and COK→MCT 22 Dec 2026, via SHJ. Passengers: 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant.
Steps
  1. Search → FareConfirm → GetOfferBundles → AddPassenger → Book
Expected Result
A booking is created for 1 adult, 1 child and 1 infant with the selected bundle applied: the Book price includes the bundle price and the baggage/entitlements reflect the bundle.
Actual Result
GetOfferBundles returned 409: [{"Name":"ServiceBundleError","Value":"No Available Bundles For the Selected Criteria"}] even though FareConfirm reported haveBundles=true. No booking was made.
Findings3Defects3Unknown-resolution
Defect — BUG-01 (new)
GetAncillary returns only Meal items — no Baggage and no Seat — for every AirArabiaPlus/USA offer tested (§2.6–2.9, OW-ANC-01)
Field: segmentsAncillariesDetails (Baggage and Seat categories)
Expected value: segmentsAncillariesDetails.<segment> includes items with ancillaryCategory "Baggage" and "Seat" as well as "Meal"
Impact: Seat and baggage ancillaries cannot be booked through GetAncillary although FareConfirm reports offerHasAncillary=true and offerHasSeat=true; the 8 ancillary booking cases cannot be completed as specified See full bug report.
Evidence: All 8 ancillary cases (OW-ANC-01, OW-ANC-02, RT-ANC-01, RT-ANC-02, OWC-ANC-01, OWC-ANC-02, RTC-ANC-01, RTC-ANC-02): categories offered = Meal only (6 items per segment).
Defect — BUG-02 (new)
Book accepts selectedBundles but does not apply the bundle: price and baggage are unchanged (§2.4/§2.9, OW-BUN-01)
Field: selectedOffer.priceDetails.totalAmount / baggageDetails (selectedBundles not applied)
Expected value: totalAmount = pre-bundle total + bundle price (e.g. 4052.62 + 635.44 = 4688.06 EGP for bundle 66580) and checked baggage 20/30 Kg per the bundle
Impact: A customer who selected a paid bundle is booked on the Basic fare with no checked baggage, and the bundle fee is not charged — pricing and entitlements are wrong in the PNR See full bug report.
Evidence: Same result in all 5 booked bundle cases (OW-BUN-01, OW-BUN-02, RT-BUN-01, OWC-BUN-01, OWC-BUN-02). OW-BUN-01: {"sel":["66580"],"bundlePrice":"ADT 635.44 EGP","fcTotal":"4052.62 EGP","bookTotal":"4052.62 EGP","bookBaggage":"{\"carryOnBaggage\":\"10 Kg (7 Kg bag + 3 Kg personal item)\",\"checkInBaggage\":\"No Checked baggage\"}","applied":false}.
Defect — BUG-03 (new)
GetOfferBundles returns 409 "No Available Bundles" for return-connection offers whose FareConfirm reports haveBundles=true; ErrorCode equals ErrorMessage (§2.4/§2.9, RTC-BUN-01)
Field: bundleChoices
Expected value: bundleChoices populated, or haveBundles=false on FareConfirm for an offer that has no bundles; ErrorMessage a readable sentence instead of repeating the code
Impact: Bundle booking is impossible for return-connection itineraries (MCT↔COK via SHJ), and the capability flag cannot be trusted to gate the call; the error text gives a client nothing to show See full bug report.
Evidence: RTC-BUN-01 and RTC-BUN-02: FareConfirm haveBundles=true, then GetOfferBundles 409 {"ErrorCode":"NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999","ErrorMessage":"NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999","Context":[{"Name":"ServiceBundleError","Value":"No Available Bundles For the Selected Criteria"}]}.
Unknown-resolution
Search/FareConfirm/... responses carry a server-issued CorrelationId in a response header (not in the JSON body); the client-sent CorrelationId is replaced by it for the rest of the flow. Exact header name not recorded. (OW-BAS-02)
Unknown-resolution
Search availability for SHJ↔COK is not stable: identical requests returned offers for some cases and an empty offers array for others (OW-BAS-01 returned 1 offer on its first run and none on re-run; RT-BAS-01 and RT-BUN-02 returned none twice; 3 further probe searches returned none). (RT-BAS-01)
Unknown-resolution
GetAncillary lists availability only for the adult and child passengers; the infant (INF) has no entry in passengersAncillariesAvailabilty. (OW-ANC-02)
